description: This file declares the interface for the IARM-Bus API, which is used for inter-process communication in RDK systems. It includes function prototypes for initializing, connecting, event handling, and RPC methods, as well as type definitions for event handlers and RPC calls.
published: IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, void *data, size_t len)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, IARM_EventHandler_t handler)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, IARM_EventHandler_t handler)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_Call(const char *ownerName,  const char *methodName, void *arg, size_t argLen)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout(const char *ownerName,  const char *methodName, void *arg, size_t argLen, int timeout)

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM-Bus library and registers the application with a unique name.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Term
methods.description: Terminates the IARM-Bus library and releases resources.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Connects the application to the IARM bus daemon to enable event and RPC communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the application from the IARM bus, stopping reception of events and RPC calls.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Publishes an asynchronous event to all registered clients.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler callback for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_UnRegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Removes all handlers registered for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a specific event handler for an event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers an RPC method for remote invocation.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Invokes a remote RPC method with a timeout.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEvent
methods.description: Registers the set of event IDs that the application can publish.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_WritePIDFile
methods.description: Writes the process ID to a specified file.
